title: containers/storage still accepts issues with no filing-time redirect here
body:
Today I filed `containers/storage#2402` and received an automated reply: "This repository has been migrated to https://github.com/containers/container-libs. Please open your issue there." — i.e., the redirect happens AFTER the wasted filing step.

The old repo has no filing-time pointer: its `.github/` contains only `renovate.json5` plus `workflows` (no `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`, no `config.yml` `contact_links`), and `CONTRIBUTING.md` still sends reporters to `github.com/containers/storage/issues`. The README does mention the move, but nothing in the filing flow (web New Issue page, `gh issue create`) surfaces it — I never saw it.

Ask: add a filing-time redirect in `containers/storage` — e.g. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` with `contact_links` pointing at the container-libs issue tracker (and/or a default issue template carrying the pointer, or disabling Issues there with a pinned redirect). That saves every filer — and the responder bot — a round trip. (`containers/storage#2402` is the motivating example.)
